page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose cloud instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, delivering a total of 128 vCPUs alongside 512 GB of system memory. This maintains a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, positioning it for enterprise workloads that require proportional scaling of compute capacity and RAM.

The instance architecture features a baseline network throughput of 64 Gbps to support high-volume network communications. It lacks local NVMe SSD storage and dedicated GPU accelerators, meaning persistent data storage and high-throughput disk operations rely entirely on attached cloud block storage volumes.

Due to its substantial core count and memory capacity, ecs.g7.32xlarge provides high resource density on a single node. This hardware configuration is suited for enterprise application servers, large-scale web microservices, distributed caching layers, continuous integration build clusters, and data processing tasks that demand high parallel CPU performance without specialized hardware acceleration.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors clocked at 2.7 GHz. Equipped with 512 GB of system memory, it provides a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The server supports a high network bandwidth baseline of 64 Gbps for communication across cloud infrastructure. It does not include integrated local NVMe storage or discrete GPU hardware, relying on external block storage services for data storage needs. Managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides high compute and memory density suitable for multi-threaded enterprise workloads, distributed web application backends, container orchestration nodes, and continuous integration pipelines.
